Carry a PESTO calibration into flexyBayes

Source: R/fb_pesto.R
fb_pesto.Rd

Ingests a calibrated simulation ensemble (a PESTO pesto_ensemble_manifest, or any C5-conforming source via as_fb_ensemble()) and returns the flexyBayes-ready artefacts for the "generalise" step of the calibration -> validation -> generalisation pipeline: the canonical fb_ensemble(), an informative prior derived from the calibrated parameters (fb_prior_from_ensemble()), and the per-parameter moment summary. The resulting $prior is passed straight to flexybayes(..., prior = ).

Usage

fb_pesto(x, method = c("moments", "pesto", "kde"), parameters = NULL)

Arguments

x

A C5 ensemble source (PESTO manifest, fb_ensemble, list, or path).

method

Prior-construction method passed to fb_prior_from_ensemble(); "moments" (default), "pesto", "kde".

parameters

Optional subset of parameter columns for the prior.

Value

An object of class c("fb_pesto", "list") with components ensemble (the fb_ensemble()), prior (the derived fb_prior()), moments (a data.frame of parameter, mean, sd), method, and provenance.

Details

quorum never executes the simulator (APSIM is run upstream by apsimx); this verb consumes the calibration result through the contract.

See also

fb_prior_from_ensemble(), as_fb_ensemble().

Examples

e <- fb_ensemble(
  params = data.frame(k = stats::rnorm(50, 2, 0.3)),
  outputs = data.frame(yield = stats::rnorm(50))
)
res <- fb_pesto(e)
res$prior
#> <fb_prior> 1 specification
#>   b("k") ~ normal(mean = 1.974134, sd = 0.3413884)
